prompt: I want to build something in Flowise for our support team. A customer email comes in, we classify it into billing / bug / feature-request / other, and if it's billing we need to call our internal invoice API (GET https://api.internal/invoices?email=X) before drafting the reply. Everything else goes straight to a draft reply. How should I actually wire this up? Which node types, and how do I get the classification result to control the branch?
assertions: Uses real Agentflow V2 node identifiers, no invented node names
States that flow state keys must be declared in the Start node before they can be written
Recommends structured JSON output for the classification rather than parsing prose
Branches on the stored classification with a Condition node rather than raw model text
Covers the HTTP node (or a justified Custom Function) for the invoice API call
